title: Battle of Suez (1541)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Suez (1541)", at revision 1370590062, opens: "The Battle of Suez occurred in 1541 and was a failed attack by the Portuguese against the Ottomans." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q113648919, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1541 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
